'''Enforcement Guides''' were armed keepers of the peace on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]], similar to [[Security Guide]]s. Enforcement Guides were responsible for bringing people before the [[High Court (Kegan)|High Court]].
